T-p2-ratelimit.title: Rate limiter module
T-p2-ratelimit.objective: Implement apps/api/src/ratelimit.ts exporting createRateLimiter({limit, windowMs, maxKeys?, now?}) returning {check(key), sweep(), size()}, so that every test in apps/api/test/ratelimit.test.ts passes. Read that test file first; it is the spec and you must not edit it. Fixed window per key, deny does not extend the window, retryAfterSec is whole seconds rounded up (min 1), fail closed for new keys when maxKeys live keys are tracked (evict expired keys first). No dependencies.

T-p2-ratelimit.summary: I implemented apps/api/src/ratelimit.ts to the spec. 7 of 8 tests pass and tsc is clean. The remaining test, 'tells the caller how long to wait', contradicts two other tests, so I could not make it pass without breaking them. I did not edit the test file or bend the implementation to fit it.
criteriaSatisfied: Deny does not extend the window
retryAfterSec is whole seconds rounded up, min 1
Fail closed for new keys at maxKeys, after evicting expired keys
criteriaUnsatisfied: All tests in ratelimit.test.ts pass: the 'whole seconds, rounded up, at least 1' test (lines 17-25) fails
risks: The failing test: limit 1, windowMs 60000. The first check is at t0, then the clock advances 10500 and 49999, so the second denial is expected at t0+60499. The window ended at t0+60000, so any fixed window that starts fresh once the window has elapsed would allow that request. The test 'starts a fresh window after the window elapses' (line 34) and the 'does not extend the window' test (line 43) both require that behavior at exactly the window boundary. The test most likely meant to advance 49_499 (total 59_999), which gives retryAfterSec 1. An owner needs to fix that number in the test; I was not allowed to.
T-p2-ratelimit.nextTask: Owner to correct the test at line 23 (advance 49_999 to 49_499) or confirm the intended semantics, then re-run the required checks.
